description: This file defines a Flutter widget for displaying expense reports, including income, expenses, and a spending trend chart. It utilizes provider for state management and constructs its UI with various Flutter widgets.

classes.name: ReportsScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays expense reports, including income, expenses, and a spending trend chart based on data from ReportsProvider.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the ReportsScreen, utilizing provider to get report data and constructing UI components such as Text and SpendingTrendChart.
